verdict.rationale: Masking or redacting sensitive data before storage is a fair question for an LLM tracing and observability platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no masking or redaction feature. Related items do not count: self-hosting keeps data on your own infrastructure, and Data Retention Policies govern deletion, but neither redacts trace contents before they are stored.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces
